answer: Context-bound attention ledger.** Each identity must answer a steady stream of small, randomly scheduled micro-tasks tied to a physical site—reserve a wharf slot, inspect a terrace sensor, wander a delivery route—within a short window. Answers are cross-checked against neighbors performing the same task. An attacker pays the real cost of staffing every fake identity with a live, location-matched responder continuously, since idle identities decay and cannot bank attention for later bursts.
